It seems to react when near some surfaces.
Keeping this item in your inventory may yield further insights.
Try keeping this in your inventory alongside a Runic Tablet while exploring the End dimension.

A Remnant in your inventory is acting strangely
The Remnant seems to be reacting to a nearby block
item.simplyswords.tampered_remnant_descr: It appears to have been tampered with somehow...
item.simplyswords.decayingrelicsworditem: Try keeping this in your inventory while exploring the deepest, darkest depths of the Overworld.
item.simplyswords.magicythe.event: Your Decaying Relic has begun making sounds
item.simplyswords.magicythe.event2: Your Decaying Relic seems to be reacting to this area
item.simplyswords.magiblade.event: Your Decaying Relic seems to be quivering
item.simplyswords.magiblade.event2: Your Decaying Relic seems gravitated to the block beneath you
item.simplyswords.magispear.event: Your Decaying Relic seems to have been influenced by something
item.simplyswords.magispear.event2: Your Decaying Relic seems to be reacting to the darkness
item.simplyswords.firesworditem.tooltip2: Chance on hit to spew forth explosive brimstone.
item.simplyswords.bramblesworditem.toolt: Chance on hit to release a swarm of toxic spores that orbit you and inflict increasingly devastating effects on nearby enemies.
The spores will remain active as long as they have a target within range, and can remain active at reduced effectiveness even when swapping weapons.
item.simplyswords.stormsworditem.tooltip: When raining/wet: Chance on hit to bring lightning down from the sky upon your foes.
While channelled, gain resistance and create a localised storm that rains lightning down on nearby enemies.
item.simplyswords.watchersworditem.toolt: Chance on hit to rip the life from a target below %d%% HP and grant some of it as absorption to the wielder.
Chance on hit to siphon the health of nearby enemies, healing the wielder.
item.simplyswords.plaguesworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to convert positive effects into their negative counterpart.
item.simplyswords.emberiresworditem.tool: Channel energy into the blade. Upon release, send forth fiery hot shrapnel at the nearest target in front of you, dealing increased damage the longer the channel.
Releasing the channel within the last second allows you to fire an additional piece of shrapnel.
When releasing shrapnel, you have a chance relative to your channel time to gain Speed, Haste, and Strength.
Chance on hit to ignite your target and send them flying.
Channel your fury, exchanging health to gain resistance, whilst causing tremors that pull enemies towards you.
Stop channelling to unleash your fury, launching, igniting, and dealing more damage the longer the channel.
item.simplyswords.ferocitysworditem.tool: Chance on hit to increase your attack speed, stacking up to 15 times.
Consume all stacks, gaining strength, for a duration equal to the amount of stacks consumed.
item.simplyswords.rendsworditem.tooltip2: Chance on hit to inflict stacking weakening effects.
item.simplyswords.rendsworditem.tooltip4: Consume all stacks from surrounding foes, damaging them and healing you relative to the stacks consumed.
item.simplyswords.soulsworditem.tooltip2: Chance on hit to absorb nearby souls, toughening and slowing the attack speed of the wielder.
item.simplyswords.soulsworditem.tooltip4: Release the souls, transferring the attack speed debuff to nearby foes and regenerating the wielder.
item.simplyswords.stealsworditem.tooltip: Chance on hit to absorb your opponents soul, hastening you while slowing and marking your target for death.
If within 5 blocks of a soulless target, return their soul, leap forward, and gain invisibility.
If more than 5 blocks from a soulless target, blink to their location, returning their soul with force, blinding and damaging them.
item.simplyswords.soulpyresworditem.tool: An expanding zone forms around you. Each pulse heals you and damages enemies.
While active, you gain knockback resistance and take 50% reduced damage.
item.simplyswords.frostfallsworditem.too: Throw Frostfall forward. Airtime and angle affect impact damage.
After landing, Frostfall pulses 5 times, damaging, slowing,  and pulling enemies.
item.simplyswords.moltenedgesworditem.to: Chance on hit to ignite your enemy or yourself. If low HP, gain regeneration instead.
Gain strength and speed relative to missing HP.
Release a powerful roar, knocking back and igniting nearby enemies. Gain resistance and onslaught with a duration relative to enemies hit.
item.simplyswords.livyatansworditem.tool: Throw Livyatan forward. Airtime and angle affect impact damage.
On return, Livyatan slows and damages enemies.
item.simplyswords.icewhispersworditem.to: While wielded, gain a frost aura that deals damage and slows enemies within %d blocks.
Drain your hunger in order to summon a blizzard at your location, slowing and dealing increased damage to enemies within %d blocks.
item.simplyswords.arcanethystsworditem.t: Chance on hit to levitate your target.
Channel your arcane energy to assault nearby enemies, lifting them into the air while dealing damage over time, then slamming them into the ground.
Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Momentarily slow yourself and charge your weapon, dealing area damage to nearby foes.
Once charged, dash forward, gaining haste and dealing enormous damage to enemies in your path.
item.simplyswords.stormsedgesworditem.to: Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Jolt forward like lightning, gaining momentary invulnerability as well as lingering speed and haste.
item.simplyswords.lichbladesworditem.too: Tortured souls radiate from you, damaging any nearby enemies.
Command your souls to attack a distant target, dealing rapid damage. Chance to siphon health.
After the attack subsides, your souls return to you and, when reaching you, grant you absorption.
Focus energy to a single point of your blade, allowing you to momentarily block incoming attacks.
When successfully timing this ability with an enemy melee swing you will perform a parry, dealing damage and launching your opponent while also reducing the ability cooldown.
Performing parries in succession will increase the ability damage and cooldown.
item.simplyswords.shadowmistsworditem.to: Chance on hit to deal magic damage that scales with your targets armor value.
Create a blinding shadowy mist at your feet and shadowstep forward a short distance.
item.simplyswords.harbingersworditem.too: Chance on hit to inflict weakness.
Summons an Abyssal Battle Standard that pulls, damages, and slows enemies whilst periodically granting haste to friendly players within its vicinity.
item.simplyswords.sunfiresworditem.toolt: Chance on hit to regenerate health.
Summons a Righteous Battle Standard that ignites, damages, and slows enemies whilst periodically granting strength and health to friendly players within its vicinity.
item.simplyswords.whisperwindsworditem.t: Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Perform a swift forward dash, gaining resistance and absorption, and inflicting enemies in your path with Echo. For every target hit by the dash, the amount of Echo you inflict is increased.
item.simplyswords.emberlashsworditem.too: Attacking enemies inflicted with Smouldering causes you to deal an additional %d damage per stack.
Evade backwards while cauterising your wounds, healing for %d%% of Max HP.
item.simplyswords.waxweaversworditem.too: Attacking ignited enemies grants you Strength and Haste.
When you would die, you are instead imbued with regenerative wax, healing you to full and granting resistance for a short time.
This effect can only occur once every %ds. Mainhand only.
item.simplyswords.hiveheartsworditem.too: Release an angry bee on hit that stings your target before disappearing.
This effect can only occur once every %ds.
Your bees focus on producing regenerative honey, healing you over time but placing the Hivemind ability on cooldown.
item.simplyswords.starsedgesworditem.too: During the day, your attacks inflict %s additional damage.
At night, your attacks gain lifesteal.
Activate a second time to dash forward, gaining resistance and haste.
item.simplyswords.wickpiercersworditem.t: Throw Wickpiercer, gaining frenzy stacks that grant attackspeed and allow you
item.simplyswords.tempestsworditem.toolt: Your attacks attach elemental energy to the target, causing damage over time and element specific debuffs.
Return all nearby elements to yourself, forming a vortex of elemental energy around you, damaging nearby enemies and growing in size.
item.simplyswords.dreadtidesworditem.too: Passively generate stacks of Voidcloak, increasing attack speed and reducing incoming damage by 10% per stack.
Taking damage removes a stack. Max 1 stack per 20 corruption.
Release your Voidcloak and send eldritch energy toward the nearest enemy, dealing rapid damage.
Wielding this weapon inflicts you with corruption over time.
item.simplyswords.flamewindsworditem.too: When a flame seed detonates, gain Haste.
Plant a seed of flame within the nearest enemy, dealing damage over time.
Upon expiring, the seed detonates, dealing area damage and spreading the effect to nearby enemies.
item.simplyswords.ribboncleaversworditem: Wielding Ribboncleaver causes you to move 5% slower, but take 15% less damage.
Dash forward, shrugging off the next few incoming hits, gaining knockback resistance, and causing your next attack to deal +95% damage to a single target.
item.simplyswords.magiscythesworditem.to: Attacking enemies while Magistorm is active grants a chance to repair an equipped item.
A localised magical storm manifests above you, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Each time the storm strikes, it has a chance to refresh its duration and increases its severity.
item.simplyswords.enigmasworditem.toolti: While you are near to your twister, gain Haste.
Summon a twister that chases down nearby enemies, dealing increased damage the longer an enemy remains trapped within.
item.simplyswords.magibladesworditem.too: The Magiblade occasionally detects and repels approaching enemies.
After a short delay, your Magiblade releases a sonic boom in front of you, dealing damage to enemies caught in its path.
item.simplyswords.magispearsworditem.too: Chance on hit to deal additional magic damage.
Throw the Magispear and perform a forward leap, followed by a slam attack, damaging nearby enemies.
item.simplyswords.caelestissworditem.too: While wielded, grants a chance to completely avoid incoming damage.
Briefly step into the astral plane, becoming immune to damage for %ds
Upon leaving the astral plane, release a violent explosion, dealing area damage relative to the damage negated while in the astral plane.
item.simplyswords.wraithfangsworditem.to: Throw Wraithfang and leap towards its position, briefly becoming immune to damage.
item.simplyswords.chompolotlsworditem.to: Axolotls attack nearby enemies, and can be perched on your shoulders to provide area buffs.
A faint power seems to emanate from within.
A growing power seems to emanate from within.
item.simplyswords.levitationsworditem.to: Chance on hit to reverse the effects of gravity on your target.
item.simplyswords.speedsworditem.tooltip: Chance on hit to increase the wielders movespeed for a duration.
item.simplyswords.slownesssworditem.tool: Chance on hit to slow the target for a duration.
item.simplyswords.freezesworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to chill or freeze your target.
item.simplyswords.wildfiresworditem.tool: Chance on hit to ignite all nearby entities of the same type as your target.
item.simplyswords.zephyrsworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to gain attack and move speed.
item.simplyswords.shieldingsworditem.too: Chance on hit to gain absorption.
item.simplyswords.stoneskinsworditem.too: Chance on hit to increase your resistance at the cost of speed.
item.simplyswords.trailblazesworditem.to: Chance on hit to gain speed and ignite yourself.
item.simplyswords.weakensworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to slow and weaken your target.
item.simplyswords.unstablesworditem.tool: Regularly apply random effects to the wielder.
item.simplyswords.activedefencesworditem: Regularly fires arrows at nearby enemies (Requires Arrows).
item.simplyswords.frostwardsworditem.too: Regularly fires movement impairing snowballs at all nearby enemies.
item.simplyswords.momentumsworditem.tool: Gain a brief moment of strong forward momentum.
item.simplyswords.imbuedsworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to deal additional magic damage, scaling with durability.
item.simplyswords.pincushionsworditem.to: Deal additional damage for each arrow stuck in your body.
item.simplyswords.wardsworditem.tooltip2: Sacrifice half your current HP to gain pulsing absorption relative to your remaining HP for 6 seconds.
item.simplyswords.immolationsworditem.to: Gain an aura of immolation, periodically damaging you and nearby foes. Outgoing damage scales with your current HP.
item.simplyswords.throwingsworditem.tool: Can be thrown, and has innate Loyalty III.
item.simplyswords.runic_tablet.tooltip: Can be used to craft and
item.simplyswords.runic_tablet.tooltip3: Can also be used to repair Unique weapons.
item.simplyswords.uniquesworditem.nether: ◆  Echo
Your weapon swings echo, dealing additional unmitigated damage after a short delay.
◆  Berserk
When you have an armour value less than 10, your weapon swings siphon health from the target.
◆  Radiance
When hitting a target afflicted with weakness, gain Immolation for a short duration.
◆  Onslaught
When hitting a target afflicted with slowness, gain Onslaught for a short duration. (Onslaught grants you pulsing haste, but inflicts you with weakness when it expires).
◆  Nullification
Summons a Battle Standard on hit that periodically cleanses debuffs from allied players, while stripping buffs from enemies within its vicinity.
◆  Precise
Chance to gain several stacks of Precision when activating a signature ability.
◆  Mighty
Chance to gain several stacks of Might when activating a signature ability.
◆  Stealthy
Chance to gain Stealth when activating a signature ability.
◆  Renewed
When activating a signature ability, you have a chance to significantly reduce its cooldown.
◆  Accelerant
Berserker's Berserking signature ability no longer grants you Berserking, but its cooldown is reduced significantly.
◆  Leaping
When landing a Leap Slam you have a chance to immediately leap again.
◆  Spellshield
Chance on spell cast to gain Barrier.
◆  Spellforged
While in your mainhand, this weapon grants you increased spell power.
◆  Soulshock
While held, this weapon grants you increased Soul & Lightning spell power.
◆  Spell Standard
Chance on spell hit to drop a Spell Standard that grants Precision & Spellforged.
◆  War Standard
When using a forward charge ability, drop a War Standard that grants Might and reveals nearby enemies.
◆  Deception
When you evade an attack using Evasion Mastery, you have a chance to cleanse Revealed.

simplyswords.weapon_attributes.typeDamag:
The damage values of weapons can be modified by adjusting their weights.
This is not the outputted damage value you see in game, but it affects it directly.
Calculation: vanilla tool material damage + base_modifier + modifier = actual modifier.
Changes require game restart to take effect.

§a[Damage Modifiers]§7
Example use-case: Adding 3 to a value below will INCREASE the in-game damage of that weapon type by 3.
simplyswords.weapon_attributes.materialD: Damage modifiers scale off these base values.
simplyswords.weapon_attributes.typeAttac: Recommended range: -1.0 to -3.7, with -1.0 being fast and -3.7 being slow.
simplyswords.weapon_attributes.uniqueDam:
Uniques scale a little bit differently and only require one modifier.
This is not the outputted damage value you see in game, but it affects it directly.
Calculation: Vanilla netherite tool damage + damage_modifier = actual modifier.

§6[Damage Modifiers]§7
Example use-case: Adding 3 to a value below will INCREASE the in-game damage of that weapon by 3.
